title: read
description: Read a file or artifact from the workspace. Small files return full content; large files return an outline plus relevant ranges with elision markers. Never silently truncates.

path.description: workspace://, worktree://, or artifact:// URI of the file or artifact to read.

range.description: Optional line range to read. If omitted, the full file or an outline is returned.

symbol.description: Optional symbol name; if given, returns the symbol's definition plus its references.

continuation.description: Continuation token from a previous truncated read.
